source: Crown–Indigenous Relations and Northern Affairs Canada, Historic treaties and Modern treaties datasets
notes: Read per feature from the ArcGIS REST distributions with a 250 m generalization in Statistics Canada Lambert (EPSG:3347), merged where one treaty is drawn as two areas, simplified with mapshaper (weighted Visvalingam, 3 km interval, keep-shapes), clipped to the province map's land outline, islands and slivers under 20 km² dropped, reprojected to WGS84, quantized to 1e4.
outside: land not inside any historic (pre-1975) treaty area, computed here. It is not an official CIRNAC layer, and parts of it are covered by modern treaties.

Names, parties and links come from the ANNOTATIONS table in scripts/data/treaties.ts, written from CIRNAC's treaty pages. Years are from the dataset's names unless the table overrides them; for several modern treaties that is the year the agreement took effect rather than the year it was signed.
Treaty areas with no land left after clipping: none.

objects.outside: land outside every historic treaty area

properties.name: display name
properties.era: historic (pre-1975) or modern (comprehensive land claim agreement)
properties.yearNote: extra note on the year, or empty
properties.href: link to the treaty text or a CIRNAC page
properties.noSurrender: 1 for treaties that did not surrender land (Peace and Friendship)
